content: {"rules": ["Model forecasts consistently underestimate prices, especially during bullish sentiment periods.", "Sentiment spikes often precede sharp price reversals, indicating model lag in capturing sentiment-driven momentum.", "Forecast bias toward gradual upward trends masks sudden volatility, particularly when sentiment is mixed.", "High sentiment values correlate with overestimation of future prices, suggesting model overconfidence in trending markets.", "Model forecasts fail to account for mean-reversion when sentiment shifts abruptly from bullish to bearish.", "Price overshoots are common in early forecast windows, especially when sentiment is strongly bullish.", "Sentiment history should be weighted more heavily in forecasting models to capture behavioral market shifts.", "Forecast accuracy improves when models incorporate recent sentiment volatility alongside historical price patterns."]}
